title: history.archive Body Schema
description: Body schema for history.archive command topic. Carries compressed turn history evicted from Concierge HOT tier for archival to K0 storage.

turn_ids.description: Ordered list of turn ordinals being archived.

session_id.description: Session UUID these turns belong to.

first.description: First turn ordinal in this archive batch.

last.description: Last turn ordinal in this archive batch.

compressed_summary.description: LLM-generated summary of archived turns. Used for context reconstruction.

evicted_reason.description: Reason turns were evicted from HOT tier.

turn_count.description: Number of turns in this archive batch.

compressed.description: Whether raw turn data is gzip-compressed.

raw_turns.description: Optional raw turn objects. May be null if only summary is archived.
